name: grainy-duotone-redbar
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a gritty screenprint / risograph-style portrait poster, with extreme heavy grain giving a photocopied, stippled poster texture.
· GROUND: a flat backdrop filled with a dense repeating stamped graphic motif in red and blue, tiled edge to edge behind the subject.
· SIGNATURE: a bold solid flat red bar painted straight across the eyes like a censor blindfold, hard-edged over the face.
· LIGHT: high-contrast, flattened, posterised tonality — blown highlights and dense blacks with little midtone.
· PALETTE: three colours only — electric cobalt blue, fire-engine red and dense black — over blown-out pale skin.
· TEXTURE: massive dusty grain and halftone noise across the entire image, a DIY punk-print feel.
· MOOD: bold, graphic, confrontational underground-zine energy.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
